answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh lantern. That converts its pearl from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the orchard behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 13cgg.
